newsitem.title: UK: Alexon jumps as results impress.
newsitem.headline: Alexon jumps as results impress.

text.p: Shares in Alexon Group Plc jumped to their highest level in more than four and a half years after the UK retailer posted a sparkling set of results, dealers and analysts said.
At 1413 GMT, the shares were up 16p to 204-1/2.
Shares in most other UK retailers, meanwhile, were flat to weaker.
Alexon said its full year pre-tax rose to 10.1 million stg from 3.0 million stg in the previous year.
In addition, the UK women's clothing retailer said its sales were off to a good start in the first six weeks of the current year.

"The new management put in place in '93 has done a wonderful job of turning this company around," said Dresdner Kleinwort Benson stores analyst Robert Miller. "We've had a 'buy' (rating) on (the stock) for a long time. It still has a lot further to go." -- London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
